rule.description: A protected/private class member, or a module-scoped non-exported function or constant, is dead when no reachable path from a live entry point of the production sources (exported public API, the lit / custom-element framework contract, or module top-level registration code) references it. Reachability is a whole-project mark-and-sweep over the cross-file reference graph, so leftovers that only reference each other are still reported.

checks.description: Report every protected or private instance member of a non-exported-instantiation component class, and every module-scoped non-exported function, that the whole-project mark-and-sweep cannot reach from live entry points (exported module symbols, the lit custom-element lifecycle and render dispatch surface, decorated members, static members, constructors, accessors, and module top-level code).
checks.detected_relation: internal production symbol -> no reachable caller among live entry points of src/
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: Dead code that looks live: several declarations are textually referenced, but only by other unreachable helpers (cross-class calls into a shared base hook, in-class private chains, and a mutually referencing module function pair), so file-local or textual 'unused name' searches miss them; only reachability over the whole reference graph proves them dead.

matches.evidence: Protected size-cache field mirroring the last manually measured panel size; it is read and written only by the unreachable syncing hook in the base class and by the dead label helper in wired-progress, never by any live render or measurement path.

Protected recording hook on the shared base element that conditionally re-renders the host; its only two call sites are the dead recenterKnob method of wired-slider and the dead labelSpan method of wired-progress, both unreachable themselves.

Protected index-based programmatic selection entry that mirrors the live keyboard stepping; nothing in the component or any other module ever invokes it, and its body only feeds the dead legacy-name dispatcher.
Private dispatcher that re-fires the pre-3.0 'select' event name, duplicating the live 'selected' notification; reachable only from the dead selectByIndex method, so it never executes.
Protected index-stepping helper duplicating the live keyboard navigation of the list; no caller exists among live entry points or dead code paths that themselves execute.
Private dispatcher firing the retired 'select' event name for the list; its single call site is inside the dead stepToIndex helper, forming a dead in-class chain.

Non-exported module function computing inline panel insets for the fixed-scale draw path; its only caller is the equally unreachable scaleForViewport, forming a mutually referencing dead island in the shared drawing helpers.

Non-exported module function returning padded-viewport scale factors; referenced only by viewportPadding, so the pair keeps itself alive under textual reference counting while being unreachable from any live entry point.
Protected label-formatting helper that reports a percentage span in pixels; it only records its size through the dead base hook and reads the dead base cache, and nothing live calls it.
Protected nominal knob radius field kept from the earlier knob geometry; it is read only by the dead private pivot helper, never by the live thumb positioning.
Protected manual knob-recentering pass that routes through the dead base recording hook and the dead private pivot helper; no live code path invokes it.
Private pivot computation consuming the dead knobSize field; its only caller is the dead recenterKnob method, an orphaned private chain.
Protected frame-pacing helper duplicating the duration math already inlined in the live animation tick; zero textual call sites anywhere in the sources.

excluded.what: Exported module symbols (component classes, WiredBase, BaseCSS, Point, the drawing helpers of wired-lib)
excluded.reason: They constitute the library's public API surface; consumers outside src/ may call them, so the rule treats every export as a live root.
Lit reads these through its framework runtime, not through textual call sites.

excluded.what: Static members (styles), constructors, and get/set accessors
excluded.reason: Framework- or property-system-driven; textual reachability would misclassify them.

excluded.what: Framework-dispatched lifecycle and override names (render, updated, firstUpdated, connectedCallback, disconnectedCallback, attributeChangedCallback, wiredRender, canvasSize, draw, and the same names on derived classes)
excluded.reason: They are invoked by the lit/custom-element machinery, so they are treated as live roots even without in-repo callers.

excluded.what: Public members and module top-level statements
excluded.reason: Public members are potential API surface for a component library (protected/private members are the internal surface the rule guards); module top-level code always executes.

excluded.what: Live look-alikes with the same shape as the injected leftovers, e.g. the wired-card/wired-tabs resize fallback paths, the combo's live selectNext/selectPrevious/refreshSelection/fireSelected chain, and the listbox's live item-click and value-sync flows
excluded.reason: They are genuinely referenced from live entry points (render, updated, firstUpdated, event handlers), so the whole-project sweep must keep them live; this documents the polarity boundary the rule was tuned against on the clean tree.
